description.value: Nesters Market is a well-established Western Canadian grocery chain founded in Whistler in 1987, now operating 16+ locations across BC and Alberta. The Woodwards location in downtown Vancouver offers a full-service experience including fresh produce, natural and organic products, an in-store bakery, deli and bistro, and a pharmacy. It sits in the historic Woodwards building in the heart of Vancouver's Gastown/Downtown Eastside area, making it a convenient resupply stop for cyclists touring the city.
